findings.desc: doc-code-drift: docs/requirements/decisions/story-files-hash-material-drift.md:20-45 says storyFilesHash is recorded alongside materialHash and applies to review escalation host verdicts plus degraded fallback records, but the producer commands still do not record or accept storyFilesHash. review_escalation_fallback_set only imports/currentMaterialHash and writes materialHash in packages/main/src/handlers/review-escalation.ts:4,68-89,103-118; autopilot_review_submit has no storyFilesHash schema field in packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts:1983-1998 and appends host_verdict without storyFilesHash in packages/main/src/handlers/verdict.ts:190-203. Command-produced escalation records therefore cannot satisfy the documented adopted binding; only manually/synthetically seeded events with storyFilesHash can get the downgrade.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 19a543165: review_escalation_fallback_set schema/handler now accepts, validates when computable, returns, and persists storyFilesHash with materialHash; autopilot_review_submit schema/HostVerdict/SubmitArgs/process-event now persists storyFilesHash with materialDigest. Evidence: npm --prefix packages/main run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-escalation-smoke.js; node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs.

findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: storyFilesHash is registered/promised for REVIEW/TEST/DONE freshness gates, but the DONE test-evidence path remains materialHash-only. process-fact-levels.ts:293 promises REVIEW/TEST/DONE freshness gates for verification evidence and story-files-hash-material-drift.md:40-60 defines storyFilesHash downgrade semantics. However phase-gates.ts:551-558 writes test-evidence.json with headHash/materialHash only, verifier.ts:544-555 does the same in persistStoryValidationEvidence, TestEvidenceData in types.ts:685-708 has no storyFilesHash field, and done-oracle.ts:181-188 calls checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit without evidence.storyFilesHash while DONE snapshot checking at done-oracle.ts:151-162 compares only materialHash. An unrelated main merge can therefore still fail the DONE evidence-freshness row despite unchanged story-owned files, so the documented/registered DONE adoption is not implemented.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 19a543165: TestEvidenceData now carries optional storyFilesHash; phase-gates and verifier write currentStoryFilesHash with test-evidence.json; done-oracle passes evidence.storyFilesHash to checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit while completed DONE snapshot behavior remains material snapshot based. Evidence: npm --prefix packages/main run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/flow-stability-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/verification-freshness-smoke.js.

findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: docs/requirements/decisions/story-files-hash-material-drift.md:45 says review escalation host verdicts and degraded fallback records adopt storyFilesHash, and packages/main/src/core/review-escalation.ts:193 plus :299 only downgrade stale materialHash when event.storyFilesHash is present. The real writers packages/main/src/handlers/verdict.ts:190-203 and packages/main/src/handlers/review-escalation.ts:79-89 never persist storyFilesHash, so autopilot_review_submit/review_escalation_fallback_set records remain legacy strict-materialHash records; unrelated main merges still stale real escalation evidence while the new smoke only tests synthetic events. WHY: adopted binding behavior is promised but not delivered for production command output. severity=high
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 19a543165: real autopilot_review_submit and review_escalation_fallback_set writers now produce records with storyFilesHash so review-escalation downgrade logic is usable by command-produced events, not only synthetic events. Review-escalation smoke includes producer command coverage. Evidence: npm --prefix packages/main run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-escalation-smoke.js; node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs.

findings.desc: quality-correctness: packages/main/src/core/review-run.ts:823-833 collects storyFilesHash whole-tree drift advisories for reviewer evidence, but packages/main/src/core/machine.ts:353-354 and :782-785 decide REVIEW->TEST using only invalid bindings and never render evidenceState.advisories. WHY: if a review run becomes materialHash-stale after an unrelated main merge but storyFilesHash still matches, collectReviewerEvidenceState treats the evidence as valid and the gate can pass without showing the mandatory re-attestation warning; that is a silent drift downgrade. severity=high
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 19a543165: review-preflight now converts collectReviewerEvidenceState advisories into a non-blocking reviewer-evidence warn gate, renderPreflight prints warning details, and REVIEW->TEST preflight logs the rendered output when warnings are present even if gates pass. Evidence: npm --prefix packages/main run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/flow-stability-smoke.js.

findings.desc: doc-code-drift: docs/requirements/decisions/story-files-hash-material-drift.md:40-45 lists adopted storyFilesHash bindings as review runs, checklist verification evidence, and review escalation host verdicts/degraded fallback records, but omits DONE validation test-evidence even though the implementation now records and consumes storyFilesHash there. TestEvidenceData includes storyFilesHash in packages/main/src/core/types.ts:705-706; story_advance/validate write it to test-evidence.json in packages/main/src/handlers/phase-gates.ts:554-563 and packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:542-554; active DONE evidence freshness consumes evidence.storyFilesHash in packages/main/src/core/done-oracle.ts:181-189; and flow-stability smoke asserts matching storyFilesHash downgrades unrelated active DONE material drift in packages/main/src/tasks/flow-stability-smoke.ts:1574-1578. The docs therefore underdocument the DONE/test-evidence adopted binding requested by this story.
